summary.zh: 管理 Microsoft 365 的用户与许可
summary.en: Administer Microsoft 365 users, licenses and policies

description.zh: 规划并执行 Microsoft 365 租户配置：用户批量开通、Exchange Online 与 Teams 策略、许可证分配、条件访问和合规报告。适合接手租户治理、批量变更用户或准备审计时使用，需要全局管理员账号与相应 Graph 权限。
description.en: Plans and runs Microsoft 365 tenant work: bulk user provisioning, Exchange Online and Teams policies, license allocation, Conditional Access and compliance reporting. Requires a global admin account with Graph permissions.
